dct_description_sm:
Census Division (CD) and Census Subdivision (CSD) level data from the 2016 Census Program. Includes most of the information released as part of the Complete Profiles. Due to the complexity of the data, changes were made to the field names in order to accommodate the limitations of the database. This makes some uses harder as it requires careful use of the field names and totals to provide accurate values and analysis.

It is suggested you do not download the data in the Shapefile format due to the very long field names.  Aliases have been provided for all tables to improve readability.  Some tables also contain more than 256 columns, the maximum number of columns in Microsoft Excel in Office 2003 or earlier.
